description:
A dedicated infrared remote for the Onkyo GX-30ARC. Instead of paging through a
saved remote in the stock Infrared app, every control sits on one screen and is
one or two presses away.

## Controls

The screen runs in portrait, so turn the Flipper clockwise until it stands
tall. The D-pad ends up to the left of the screen, and the IR emitter on the
top edge points to your right — aim that at the receiver.

- **D-pad** moves between buttons
- **OK** sends the focused command
- **Back** exits

Each press sends exactly one command; holding a button does not repeat it. The
LED blinks while transmitting.

## Buttons

- Power and mute
- Play/pause
- Volume down and up
- Previous and next track
- Flat EQ preset
- Inputs: USB, Bluetooth, HDMI, AUX, RCA and OPT

The grid is taller than the screen and scrolls as the selection moves.

## Compatibility

**Tested on an Onkyo GX-30ARC.** The codes were captured from that system's own
remote with the Flipper's learn mode.

Onkyo command bytes are model-specific, so other Onkyo products may not respond
to them. If your receiver ignores the app, the table is wrong for your model
and the buttons need re-capturing — the
[source repository](https://github.com/gergely-xyz/OnkyoRemote) explains how.
